CustomField.label: Advanced: Expected Summary Text
CustomField.description: Optional. Overrides the auto-generated Expected line on a multi-row (Every record must pass) query check. Supports the count tokens {!failCount} and {!totalCount} plus {!FieldName} record tokens. Example: every contact has an email.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional friendly wording for the Expected line on a multi-row check, for example: every contact has an email.
